fidelity: F2a -- Single-Diode Cell-Level + Bypass Diode + Partial Shading
source: Miyano et al. (2016) Acc. Chem. Res.; Tress (2017) J. Phys. Chem. Lett.; typical MAPbI3 module

N_s.note: Cells in series, thin-film monolithic interconnect

I_L_ref.note: Photo-current at STC; ~20 mA/cm2 for 100 cm2 active area per cell

I_o_ref.note: Saturation current at STC; fitted for Voc~1.1V with n=1.8

R_s_cell.note: Series resistance per cell; ~5 Ohm*cm2 / 100 cm2

R_sh_cell.note: Shunt resistance per cell; ~1000 Ohm*cm2 / 100 cm2

n_diode.note: Ideality factor; 1.5-2.0 typical for trap-assisted recombination

alpha_sc.note: Isc temperature coefficient; much smaller than Si
